title: API Routes TDD - Integration Tests for Chat, Graph, and Herb Endpoints

requirements: Write 10 test cases in test_routes.py (or separate test_chat.py, test_graph.py, test_herb.py): chat tests [test_ask_question, test_get_session, test_create_session], graph tests [test_get_herb_graph, test_search_nodes, test_get_node, test_get_pending], herb tests [test_get_herb, test_list_herbs]
Mock underlying services (ChatService, GraphService) for isolated route testing
Apply 3 refactorings: [extract route testing helpers, add response validation helpers, create consistent mock fixtures]
acceptance: 10 tests pass: verify by cd packages/api && pytest tests/api/test_routes.py -v --tb=short (or combined)
Coverage >=80%: verify by cd packages/api && pytest tests/api/ --cov=app.api --cov-report=term-missing
All endpoints return expected status codes and response structures

artifacts.contains: get_herb_graph, search_nodes, get_node, get_pending, find_path endpoints

pre_analysis.action: Load context package for API route structure

implementation_approach.title: Red Phase - Write Failing Tests
implementation_approach.description: Write 10 integration test cases for API routes
modification_points: Create tests/api/ directory structure (if not exists)
Write 3 chat tests, 4 graph tests, 3 herb tests (10 total)
Mock underlying services for isolated route testing
Use client fixture for all HTTP-level testing

Write test_get_pending: GET /graph/pending returns pending verifications
Write test_get_herb: GET /herb/{id} returns herb details
Write test_list_herbs: GET /herb/ returns paginated herb list

implementation_approach.title: Green Phase - Implement to Pass Tests
implementation_approach.description: Verify/implement API routes to pass all integration tests
modification_points: Verify chat.py endpoints properly delegate to ChatService
Verify graph.py endpoints properly delegate to graph_service
Verify herb.py endpoints properly return herb data
Ensure all endpoints return proper status codes and response formats

Check chat.py session endpoints handle session management

Check graph.py search_nodes calls appropriate graph_service method

Run tests - if failures, investigate route implementation

implementation_approach.title: Refactor Phase - Improve Code Quality
implementation_approach.description: Apply refactorings to improve API route test quality
modification_points: Apply 3 refactorings: extract route testing helpers, add response validation, create consistent mock fixtures
logic_flow: Extract common test helpers: assert_response, assert_pagination
Create mock_service_fixtures for consistent service mocking
Add response validation helpers checking schema structure
Run full test suite to verify refactoring didn't break anything
